name: Pyromancer: Draconic Aspect keeps the Dracthyr model across a relog (COA-5850)
contract: Draconic Aspect (802117) shows the Dracthyr model 142067 through aura_ascension_pyromancer_draconic_form,
which calls SetDisplayId when the aura applies. On login the aura is loaded and applied, but the player's display
is restored to the native model afterwards (RestoreDisplayId only honours transform auras), so a character who
logged out in the form, or a bot logging in, kept the buff without the model. AscensionPyromancer::Refresh, which
runs every 500 ms, now puts the model back while the aura is active and the player shows the native model.

steps.label: SETUP: Draconic Aspect shows the Dracthyr model
SETUP: Draconic Aspect is still active after the relog
DISCRIMINATING: the Dracthyr model comes back after the relog
Leaving the form restores the native model
